QuestInfo.name: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] You Can Do It
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Fanzy in front of Ellinel Lake.
QuestInfo.1: Fanzy explains about the Ellinel Fairy Academy and suggets swimming across the lake. Is this really a good idea...? Better jump in.
QuestInfo.2: Well, that didn't work out at all. You should find another way.

0.0: Meow... This is the #bEllinel Fairy Academy#k. Try not to be intimidated by the brainpower on display.\r\n#L0##bEllinel Fairy Academy?#l\n#k
0.1: This is where little fairies learn to sprinkle their dust and turn up their noses to lesser beings. \r\n#L0##bWhy's it hidden so deep in the forest?#l\n#k
0.2: Don't you know anything? #bEllinia#k used to be a fairy town, before the Black Mage and his goons came and swatted them all like craneflies? That's when the humans moved in. \r\n#L0##bBut there are fairies outside of Ellinia.#l\n#k
0.3: And there are birds that don't run when they see me. Some fairies accept humans. The ones in the #bEllinel Fairy Academy#k are not those fairies.\r\n#L0##bYou think Cootie got captured by these human-hating fairies?#l\n#k
0.4: Most likely. I know I thought about using him as a scratching post a few times. Master #bGrendel#k and I tried to befriend the fairies, but they just weren't listening. I think we should use more... forceful methods.\r\n#b#h0##k, let me ask... are you a good swimmer?

yes.0: Why don't you go for a swim! Show us how brave you are, meow... \r\n#b(Cross the lake to the right.)#k

no.0: Do you want to jump in the water to amuse me anyway?

default.0: Show me your mettle! I'm getting bored.\r\n#b(Cross the lake to the right.)#k

quest.0: Show me your mettle! I'm getting bored.\r\n#b(Cross the lake to the right.)#k
